chunks: There will they drink a cup flavoured with ginger
ai.seo_question: What is the mixture of the drink in Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Insan (76:17) is often contrasted with the 'mixing of ginger' to the 'mixing of kaffar' (bitterness) in the preceding verse, symbolizing the transition from the trials of worldly life to the pure, distinct pleasure of the hereafter. Scholars note that ginger, known for its warming and purifying properties, represents a refined sustenance that enhances the sensory experience of the righteous without the intoxication or impurity found in worldly drinks. This detail underscores the divine wisdom in providing specific, beneficial qualities to the rewards of Paradise, aligning with the Shia emphasis on the physical and spiritual perfection of the afterlife.
